desc: Implement the complete `longestSpecialPath` method using a weighted adjacency list and stack-safe iterative DFS rooted at 0.
Maintain active-path `last_seen` value depths with DFS-exit restoration and a sliding uniqueness boundary.
Evaluate each visited node’s longest unique-value suffix using prefix distances, maximizing weighted length and minimizing node count on ties.
Verify the implementation with both provided samples and edge cases including duplicate values across one edge, all-single-node optima, sibling duplicates, and deep chains.
